const DRIVE_TYPES = ['Přední (FWD)', 'Zadní (RWD)', '4x4 / AWD', 'xDrive', 'Quattro', '4Motion', '4Matic'];

interface VehicleProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

const VehicleManager: React.FC<VehicleProps> = ({ 
  vehicles, 
  customers, 
  services, 
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle,
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,
  initialVehicleId,
  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingVehicleId, setEditingVehicleId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingVehicle, setDeletingVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedHistoryVehicle, setSelectedHistoryVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedDetailVehicle, setSelectedDetailVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const initialFormState = {
    customerId: '',
    make: '',
    model: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    vin: '',
    licensePlate: '',
    mileage: 0,
    engineCode: '',
    color: '', // Slouží pro "Pohon" dle UI
    stkExpirationDate: new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextServiceDate: new Date(Date.now() + 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    serviceIntervalKm: 15000,
    serviceIntervalMonths: 12,
    notes: '',
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(initialFormState);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoOpen) {
      handleAddNew();
      if (onModalOpened) onModalOpened();
    }
  }, [autoOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpenMenuId(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const filteredVehicles = vehicles
    .filter(v => 
      v.licensePlate.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.make.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.model.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.make.localeCompare(b.make, 'cs'));

  const handleEdit = (vehicle: Vehicle) => {
    setEditingVehicleId(vehicle.id);
    setFormData({
      customerId: vehicle.customerId,
      make: vehicle.make,
      model: vehicle.model,
      year: vehicle.year,
      vin: vehicle.vin,
      licensePlate: vehicle.licensePlate,
      mileage: vehicle.mileage,
      engineCode: vehicle.engineCode,
      color: vehicle.color,
      stkExpirationDate: vehicle.stkExpirationDate,
      nextServiceDate: vehicle.nextServiceDate,
      serviceIntervalKm: vehicle.serviceIntervalKm || 15000,
      serviceIntervalMonths: vehicle.serviceIntervalMonths || 12,
      notes: vehicle.notes || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
    setOpenMenuId(null);
  };

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (editingVehicleId) {
      if (!onUpdateVehicle) return;
      const vehicleToUpdate = vehicles.find(v => v.id === editingVehicleId);
      if (vehicleToUpdate) onUpdateVehicle({ ...vehicleToUpdate, ...formData });
    } else {
      if (!onAddVehicle) return;
      const newVehicle: Vehicle = { ...formData, id: `v${Date.now()}`, lastServiceDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] };
      onAddVehicle(newVehicle);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (deletingVehicle && onDeleteVehicle) {
      onDeleteVehicle(deletingVehicle.id);
      setDeletingVehicle(null);
    }
  };

  // Dynamické seznamy pro formulář
  const availableModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]) {
      return Object.keys(VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]);
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make]);

  const availableEngines = useMemo(() => {
    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make] && VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model]) {
      return VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model];
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make, formData.model]);

  const getOwnerName = (customerId: string) => {
    const owner = customers.find(c => c.id === customerId);
    return owner ? (owner.companyName || `${owner.firstName} ${owner.lastName}`) : 'Neznámý vlastník';
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-6 duration-700">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">Evidence vozidel</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Celkem {vehicles.length} vozidel v péči.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleAddNew}
          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-200"
        >
          <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
          Nové vozidlo
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3">
        <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
        <input 
          type="text" 
          placeholder="Hledat podle SPZ, značky nebo modelu..." 
          className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium outline-none bg-transparent"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
        />
        {search && (
          <button onClick={() => onSearchChange('')} className="text-blue-600 font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-all">Zrušit filtr</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6 pb-12">
        {filteredVehicles.map(v => {
          return (
            <div key={v.id} className={`bg-white rounded-3xl border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-xl transition-all group relative overflow-visible ${initialVehicleId === v.id ? 'ring-4 ring-blue-500/20 border-blue-500' : 'border-slate-100'}`}>
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 p-4">
                <div className="relative">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setOpenMenuId(openMenuId === v.id ? null : v.id)}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition-all ${openMenuId === v.id ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-900' : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    <MoreHorizontal className="w-6 h-6" />

}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

}) => {

  const [selectedDetailVehicle, setSelectedDetailVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);

'ULOŽIT ZMĚNY' : 'ULOŽIT VOZIDLO'}</button>

};

export default VehicleManager;

**Developing Database Integration**

I'm currently focused on integrating the XML data to expand the vehicle database within the application. I've narrowed down the likely target file to `components/VehicleManager.tsx` and am working through how to best parse and incorporate the manufacturers, models, and engines from the XML snippet. My immediate concern is ensuring efficient data handling and avoiding conflicts with the existing database structure.


**Integrating Ford Data**

I've made headway in incorporating Ford models into the database. I'm focusing on the `VEHICLE_DB` constant, expanding the Ford section with models like the B-MAX, C-MAX, Fiesta, and Focus. I'm keen to preserve the consistent formatting, including year ranges and engine details, while avoiding duplicates. The next step is to get the specific engine codes and details incorporated.


**Expanding Ford's Vehicle Lineup**

I'm now expanding the Ford entries within the `VEHICLE_DB` object. I am meticulously adding the models provided, including the Kuga III, Mondeo generations, S-MAX versions, Transits and Tourneo models, along with their respective year ranges. I'm taking care to format the data consistently, ensuring the correct placement within the structure of `components/VehicleManager.tsx`.


**Consolidating Ford Data**

I'm now diving into the specifics of Ford's models. I'm focusing on directly updating the `VEHICLE_DB` with the detailed engine configurations and year ranges derived from the XML data. My immediate focus is to get the correct structure in `components/VehicleManager.tsx`, carefully mapping the XML's nested data into the Javascript object's. My approach is to ensure a direct replacement, preserving existing UI functionality.

V rámci vašeho požadavku jsem kompletně zaktualizoval a rozšířil databázi vozů značky **Ford** v souboru `VehicleManager.tsx`. Data byla integrována s vysokou přesností na modelové kódy (např. WA6, DXA, DYB) a specifické kódové označení motorů (Duratorq, EcoBoost, EcoBlue), jak bylo uvedeno v přiloženém souboru.

### Provedené úpravy:
1.  **Kompletní restrukturalizace řady Ford**: Původní zjednodušené záznamy byly nahrazeny detailními generacemi s přesnými roky výroby.
2.  **Doplnění užitkové a MPV sekce**: Přibyly modely B-MAX, C-MAX, S-MAX, Galaxy, Fusion a kompletní rodina Transit (Custom, Connect, Courier) včetně generací VI-VIII.
3.  **Zpřesnění motorizací**: U každého modelu jsou nyní k dispozici přesné kódy motorů (např. SFJA, M1DA, HWDA) a jejich výkon v kW, což je klíčové pro správnou identifikaci náhradních dílů v servisu.
4.  **Technologické novinky**: Přidány hybridní verze (FHEV, PHEV) a plně elektrické modely (E-Transit).

const DRIVE_TYPES = ['Přední (FWD)', 'Zadní (RWD)', '4x4 / AWD', 'xDrive', 'Quattro', '4Motion', '4Matic'];

interface VehicleProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

const VehicleManager: React.FC<VehicleProps> = ({ 
  vehicles, 
  customers, 
  services, 
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle,
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,
  initialVehicleId,
  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingVehicleId, setEditingVehicleId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingVehicle, setDeletingVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedHistoryVehicle, setSelectedHistoryVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedDetailVehicle, setSelectedDetailVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const initialFormState = {
    customerId: '',
    make: '',
    model: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    vin: '',
    licensePlate: '',
    mileage: 0,
    engineCode: '',
    color: '', // Slouží pro "Pohon" dle UI
    stkExpirationDate: new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextServiceDate: new Date(Date.now() + 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    serviceIntervalKm: 15000,
    serviceIntervalMonths: 12,
    notes: '',
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(initialFormState);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoOpen) {
      handleAddNew();
      if (onModalOpened) onModalOpened();
    }
  }, [autoOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpenMenuId(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const filteredVehicles = vehicles
    .filter(v => 
      v.licensePlate.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.make.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.model.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.make.localeCompare(b.make, 'cs'));

  const handleEdit = (vehicle: Vehicle) => {
    setEditingVehicleId(vehicle.id);
    setFormData({
      customerId: vehicle.customerId,
      make: vehicle.make,
      model: vehicle.model,
      year: vehicle.year,
      vin: vehicle.vin,
      licensePlate: vehicle.licensePlate,
      mileage: vehicle.mileage,
      engineCode: vehicle.engineCode,
      color: vehicle.color,
      stkExpirationDate: vehicle.stkExpirationDate,
      nextServiceDate: vehicle.nextServiceDate,
      serviceIntervalKm: vehicle.serviceIntervalKm || 15000,
      serviceIntervalMonths: vehicle.serviceIntervalMonths || 12,
      notes: vehicle.notes || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
    setOpenMenuId(null);
  };

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (editingVehicleId) {
      if (!onUpdateVehicle) return;
      const vehicleToUpdate = vehicles.find(v => v.id === editingVehicleId);
      if (vehicleToUpdate) onUpdateVehicle({ ...vehicleToUpdate, ...formData });
    } else {
      if (!onAddVehicle) return;
      const newVehicle: Vehicle = { ...formData, id: `v${Date.now()}`, lastServiceDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] };
      onAddVehicle(newVehicle);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (deletingVehicle && onDeleteVehicle) {
      onDeleteVehicle(deletingVehicle.id);
      setDeletingVehicle(null);
    }
  };

  // Dynamické seznamy pro formulář
  const availableModels = useMemo(() => {
    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]) {
      return Object.keys(VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]);
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make]);

  const availableEngines = useMemo(() => {
    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make] && VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model]) {
      return VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model];
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make, formData.model]);

  const getOwnerName = (customerId: string) => {
    const owner = customers.find(c => c.id === customerId);
    return owner ? (owner.companyName || `${owner.firstName} ${owner.lastName}`) : 'Neznámý vlastník';

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">Evidence vozidel</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Celkem {vehicles.length} vozidel v péči.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleAddNew}
          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-200"
        >
          <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
          Nové vozidlo
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3">
        <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
        <input 
          type="text" 
          placeholder="Hledat podle SPZ, značky nebo modelu..." 
          className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium outline-none bg-transparent"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
        />
        {search && (
          <button onClick={() => onSearchChange('')} className="text-blue-600 font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-all">Zrušit filtr</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6 pb-12">
        {filteredVehicles.map(v => {
          return (
            <div key={v.id} className={`bg-white rounded-3xl border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-xl transition-all group relative overflow-visible ${initialVehicleId === v.id ? 'ring-4 ring-blue-500/20 border-blue-500' : 'border-slate-100'}`}>
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 p-4">
                <div className="relative">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setOpenMenuId(openMenuId === v.id ? null : v.id)}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition-all ${openMenuId === v.id ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-900' : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    <MoreHorizontal className="w-6 h-6" />
                  </button>

                  {openMenuId === v.id && (
                    <div ref={menuRef} className="absolute top-12 right-0 w-48 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 p-2 z-[60] animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
                      <button onClick={() => handleEdit(v)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 transition-colors text-sm font-bold">
                        <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                        Upravit kartu
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={() => { setDeletingVehicle(v); setOpenMenuId(null); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-50 text-red-600 transition-colors text-sm font-bold">
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        Smazat kartu
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-5 mb-6">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                  <Car className="w-8 h-8" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 leading-tight">{v.make} {v.model}</h3>
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] mt-1 inline-block uppercase tracking-wider">{v.licensePlate}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-50">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600">
                  <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg"><Fingerprint className="w-4 h-4" /></div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold truncate">{v.vin}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600">
                  <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg"><ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /></div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">STK: {formatDate(v.stkExpirationDate)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600">
                  <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg"><Clock className="w-4 h-4" /></div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Servis: {formatDate(v.nextServiceDate)}</span>

              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 flex gap-2">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDetailVehicle(v)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wider"
                >
                  Detail

                <button 
                  onClick={() => setSelectedHistoryVehicle(v)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wider"

                  Historie
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Detail Modal - View Only */}

Motorizace byly doplněny o přesné kódy motorů a výkonové parametry (kW/HP) přesně podle dodaného XML souboru.

### Provedené úpravy:
1.  **Sjednocení a zpřesnění modelů**: Modely jako 500, Panda, Punto a Tipo jsou nyní rozděleny na konkrétní vývojové řady (např. Panda II vs. Panda III).
2.  **Doplnění užitkové řady**: Přidány kompletní specifikace pro modely Ducato (II a III) a Doblo (I a II).
3.  **Speciality a moderní pohony**: Databáze nově obsahuje i model Stilo, plně elektrický Fiat 500e a hybridní jednotky FireFly.
4.  **Kontrola duplicit**: Existující obecné záznamy Fiatu byly nahrazeny těmito konkrétními daty, aby v nabídce nedocházelo k překryvům.

interface VehicleProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

  services, 
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle,
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,

  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

'ULOŽIT ZMĚNY' : 'ULOŽIT VOZIDLO'}</button>

          </div>

      )}

          width: 4px;

          background: #f1f5f9;

        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
          background: #cbd5e1;
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

export default VehicleManager;

  customers: Customer[];

  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

  onUpdateVehicle,

interface VehicleProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

  services, 
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle,
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,

  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);

'ULOŽIT ZMĚNY' : 'ULOŽIT VOZIDLO'}</button>

        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
};

const DRIVE_TYPES = ['Přední (FWD)', 'Zadní (RWD)', '4x4 / AWD', 'xDrive', 'Quattro', '4Motion', '4Matic'];

interface VehicleProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle?: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer?: (customerId: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder?: (orderId: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

const VehicleManager: React.FC<VehicleProps> = ({ 
  vehicles, 
  customers, 
  services, 
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle,
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,
  initialVehicleId,
  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingVehicleId, setEditingVehicleId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingVehicle, setDeletingVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedHistoryVehicle, setSelectedHistoryVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedDetailVehicle, setSelectedDetailVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const initialFormState = {
    customerId: '',
    make: '',
    model: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    vin: '',
    licensePlate: '',
    mileage: 0,
    engineCode: '',
    color: '', // Slouží pro "Pohon" dle UI
    stkExpirationDate: new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    nextServiceDate: new Date(Date.now() + 180 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split('T')[0],
    serviceIntervalKm: 15000,
    serviceIntervalMonths: 12,
    notes: '',
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(initialFormState);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoOpen) {
      handleAddNew();
      if (onModalOpened) onModalOpened();
    }
  }, [autoOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpenMenuId(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const filteredVehicles = vehicles
    .filter(v => 
      v.licensePlate.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.make.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      v.model.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.make.localeCompare(b.make, 'cs'));

  const handleEdit = (vehicle: Vehicle) => {
    setEditingVehicleId(vehicle.id);
    setFormData({
      customerId: vehicle.customerId,
      make: vehicle.make,
      model: vehicle.model,
      year: vehicle.year,
      vin: vehicle.vin,
      licensePlate: vehicle.licensePlate,
      mileage: vehicle.mileage,
      engineCode: vehicle.engineCode,
      color: vehicle.color,
      stkExpirationDate: vehicle.stkExpirationDate,
      nextServiceDate: vehicle.nextServiceDate,
      serviceIntervalKm: vehicle.serviceIntervalKm || 15000,
      serviceIntervalMonths: vehicle.serviceIntervalMonths || 12,
      notes: vehicle.notes || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
    setOpenMenuId(null);
  };

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (editingVehicleId) {
      if (!onUpdateVehicle) return;
      const vehicleToUpdate = vehicles.find(v => v.id === editingVehicleId);
      if (vehicleToUpdate) onUpdateVehicle({ ...vehicleToUpdate, ...formData });
    } else {
      if (!onAddVehicle) return;
      const newVehicle: Vehicle = { ...formData, id: `v${Date.now()}`, lastServiceDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] };
      onAddVehicle(newVehicle);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setFormData(initialFormState);
    setEditingVehicleId(null);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (deletingVehicle && onDeleteVehicle) {
      onDeleteVehicle(deletingVehicle.id);
      setDeletingVehicle(null);
    }
  };

  // Dynamické seznamy pro formulář

    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]) {
      return Object.keys(VEHICLE_DB[formData.make]);
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make]);

  const availableEngines = useMemo(() => {
    if (VEHICLE_DB[formData.make] && VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model]) {
      return VEHICLE_DB[formData.make][formData.model];
    }
    return [];
  }, [formData.make, formData.model]);

  const getOwnerName = (customerId: string) => {
    const owner = customers.find(c => c.id === customerId);
    return owner ? (owner.companyName || `${owner.firstName} ${owner.lastName}`) : 'Neznámý vlastník';

          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">Evidence vozidel</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Celkem {vehicles.length} vozidel v péči.</p>
        </div>
        <button 
          onClick={handleAddNew}
          className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl font-bold hover:bg-blue-700 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-blue-200"
        >
          <Plus className="w-5 h-5" />
          Nové vozidlo
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3">
        <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
        <input 
          type="text" 
          placeholder="Hledat podle SPZ, značky nebo modelu..." 
          className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium outline-none bg-transparent"
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
        />
        {search && (
          <button onClick={() => onSearchChange('')} className="text-blue-600 font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1 hover:bg-blue-50 rounded-lg transition-all">Zrušit filtr</button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6 pb-12">
        {filteredVehicles.map(v => {
          return (
            <div key={v.id} className={`bg-white rounded-3xl border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-xl transition-all group relative overflow-visible ${initialVehicleId === v.id ? 'ring-4 ring-blue-500/20 border-blue-500' : 'border-slate-100'}`}>
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 p-4">
                <div className="relative">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setOpenMenuId(openMenuId === v.id ? null : v.id)}
                    className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition-all ${openMenuId === v.id ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-900' : 'text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-900'}`}
                  >
                    <MoreHorizontal className="w-6 h-6" />
                  </button>

                  {openMenuId === v.id && (
                    <div ref={menuRef} className="absolute top-12 right-0 w-48 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 p-2 z-[60] animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
                      <button onClick={() => handleEdit(v)} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 transition-colors text-sm font-bold">
                        <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                        Upravit kartu
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={() => { setDeletingVehicle(v); setOpenMenuId(null); }} className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-red-50 text-red-600 transition-colors text-sm font-bold">
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        Smazat kartu
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-5 mb-6">
                <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">

                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 leading-tight">{v.make} {v.model}</h3>
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] mt-1 inline-block uppercase tracking-wider">{v.licensePlate}</div>

              <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-50">

                </div>

                  <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg"><ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /></div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">STK: {formatDate(v.stkExpirationDate)}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-slate-600">
                  <div className="p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg"><Clock className="w-4 h-4" /></div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold">Servis: {formatDate(v.nextServiceDate)}</span>

              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 flex gap-2">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setSelectedDetailVehicle(v)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wider"
                >
                  Detail
                </button>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setSelectedHistoryVehicle(v)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:bg-blue-100 transition-colors uppercase tracking-wider"

                  Historie
                </button>

            </div>

        })}
      </div>

      {/* Detail Modal - View Only */}
      {selectedDetailVehicle && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4">

                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center bg-blue-600">

4.  **Elektrické modely**: Doplněny nové řady Q4, Q6 a Q8 e-tron s jejich specifickým označením pohonů.

No UI elements were modified.
No user-facing texts were changed.
No environment variables were changed.

interface VehicleManagerProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  customers: Customer[];
  services: ServiceRecord[];
  onAddVehicle: (v: Vehicle) => void;
  onUpdateVehicle: (v: Vehicle) => void;
  onDeleteVehicle: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToCustomer: (id: string) => void;
  onNavigateToOrder: (id: string) => void;
  initialVehicleId?: string | null;
  autoOpen?: boolean;
  onModalOpened?: () => void;
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return '---';
  const parts = dateStr.split('T')[0].split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
  return `${parts[2]}.${parts[1]}.${parts[0]}`;
};

const VehicleManager: React.FC<VehicleManagerProps> = ({ 
  vehicles, 
  customers, 
  services,
  onAddVehicle, 
  onUpdateVehicle, 
  onDeleteVehicle,
  onNavigateToCustomer,
  onNavigateToOrder,
  initialVehicleId,
  autoOpen,
  onModalOpened,
  search,
  onSearchChange
}) => {
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingVehicle, setEditingVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [deletingVehicle, setDeletingVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [selectedVehicle, setSelectedVehicle] = useState<Vehicle | null>(null);
  const [openMenuId, setOpenMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const initialFormData: Partial<Vehicle> = {
    make: 'Škoda',
    model: '',
    year: new Date().getFullYear(),
    vin: '',
    licensePlate: '',
    mileage: 0,
    engineCode: '',
    color: '',
    stkExpirationDate: '',
    nextServiceDate: '',
    customerId: customers[0]?.id || ''
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Vehicle>>(initialFormData);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoOpen) {
      handleAddNew();
      if (onModalOpened) onModalOpened();
    }
  }, [autoOpen, onModalOpened]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialVehicleId) {
      const v = vehicles.find(item => item.id === initialVehicleId);
      if (v) setSelectedVehicle(v);

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setOpenMenuId(null);
      }

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);

  const handleAddNew = () => {
    setEditingVehicle(null);
    setFormData(initialFormData);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (v: Vehicle) => {
    setEditingVehicle(v);
    setFormData(v);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
    setOpenMenuId(null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (editingVehicle) {
      onUpdateVehicle({ ...editingVehicle, ...formData } as Vehicle);
    } else {
      onAddVehicle({ ...formData, id: `v${Date.now()}` } as Vehicle);
    }
    setIsModalOpen(false);
  };

    v.licensePlate.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
    v.make.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||

                      <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />

                    <button 
                      onClick={() => { setDeletingVehicle(v); setOpenMenuId(null); }}

                    >

                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest ml-1">Příští servis</label>
                  <input 
                    type="date" 
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 border-2 border-transparent focus:border-blue-500 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 outline-none font-bold"

                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, nextServiceDate: e.target.value})}
                  />
                </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest ml-1">Vlastník / Zákazník</label>

                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border-2 border-transparent focus:border-blue-500 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 outline-none transition-all font-bold"
